title: Ubuntu security updates
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-215.062819: TT-CSIRT Advisory – Ubuntu Security Updates
leadParagraph: Canonical has released a security update stating that it has discovered a vulnerability in its Ubuntu Linux OS where a sequence of specifically crafted selective acknowledgements (SACK) may trigger an integer overflow, leading to a denial of service or possible kernel failure.
contentHtml:
Canonical has released a security update stating that it has discovered a vulnerability in its Ubuntu Linux OS where a sequence of specifically crafted selective acknowledgements (SACK) may trigger an integer overflow, leading to a denial of service or possible kernel failure.

Further information on this vulnerability and how it can be mitigated can be found on the Ubuntu Webste at https://usn.ubuntu.com/4017-1/
